name: 109 會考模擬二模（康軒 1～3 冊）英語聽力（附聽力稿）
source: 康軒 109 學年國中教育會考模擬測驗（第二回・九年級 1～3 冊），答案與解析取自官方詳解

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
Jenny is doing her homework, but her brothers aren’t.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：Jenny 正在做她的家庭作業，但她的弟弟們沒有。（關鍵字：Jenny is doing her homework／her brothers aren’t）

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
Sam and Ted still have a bottle of milk at home. They don’t have to buy one.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：Sam 和 Ted 家裡還有一瓶牛奶。他們不必買。（關鍵字：don’t have to buy）

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
The hospital is not next to the library. It is across from the library.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：這間醫院不在圖書館旁邊。它在圖書館的對面。（關鍵字：not next to／across from）

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
When will you go to the bookstore tonight?
questions.e: 中譯：你今晚什麼時候會去書店？→ 大約七點。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
What are you going to bake this weekend?
o: I’m going to the beach with Ben.
I plan to bake a strawberry cake.
questions.e: 中譯：這個週末你要烤什麼？→ 我打算烤一個草莓蛋糕。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How much is the guitar on the right?
o: But I like the left one.
questions.e: 中譯：右邊這把吉他多少錢？→ 它要價新臺幣 2,400 元。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Where is Mike’s English teacher from?
questions.e: 中譯：Mike 的英語老師來自哪裡？→ 她來自美國。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How often does Mia go jogging?
o: She often jogs in the gym.
questions.e: 中譯：Mia 多常去慢跑？→ 一週三次。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Which dress is better for me to wear to the party, the blue one or the pink one?
questions.e: 中譯：哪一件洋裝比較適合我穿去這個派對，藍色的還是粉紅色的？→ 妳穿兩件都很好看。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Why didn’t Karen go to the movies with you?
questions.e: 中譯：為什麼 Karen 不和你一起去看電影？→ 她必須工作。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: I just invited Mr. Anderson for dinner this Saturday.
W: What?! I told you I have to work this Saturday. I won’t have time to prepare dinner.
M: I’m sorry. We can change it to another day.
W: Next Sunday will be great.
M: OK. Let me ask him first.
Q: When CAN’T the woman have dinner with Mr. Anderson?
questions.e: 由女子說「這星期六我必須工作。我沒有時間準備晚餐。」，可知答案為這星期六，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Where did you go this morning?
W: I went to the library. I wanted to borrow The White Hat, but they didn’t have it then.
M: I can lend it to you. I bought it last week, and I just finished reading it.
W: Thank you. Did you enjoy it?
M: Yes, I did. It is as good as Lisa’s songs. Everyone is surprised to know she is more than a singer. She’s also a great writer!
Q: What is The White Hat?
questions.e: 由「去圖書館」、「閱讀」及「作家」，可知 The White Hat 是一本書，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: David, this is your third visit to me this month. I know the weather is very hot, and having ice cream is great, but you shouldn’t have ice cream for every meal. It’s not good for your stomach. I’ll give you some medicine. Please take it twice a day, after lunch and dinner. You will feel better soon. But remember, stop having that much ice cream.
Q: What does the man do?
questions.e: 由「這對你的胃不好。我會開一些藥給你。」，可知這位男子是醫生，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
B: What should we write or draw here?
G: How about drawing some flowers?
B: That’s a great idea. But let’s not draw. Let’s make flowers with color paper.
G: Then we can put the flowers in a circle and write something to show our thanks in the middle.
B: Sounds great! I hope Mom will like it.
Q: What might the boy and the girl be doing?
questions.e: 由「在中間寫些東西來表達我們的謝意」、「我希望媽媽會喜歡」，可知是在做卡片給媽媽，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Are you ready to order?
W: Wait. I’m still thinking. I like beef noodles, but it’s quite warm today. I don’t want to have hot soup.
M: You can order beef rice then.
W: But they have tomatoes in the rice, right? I tried it once, and it tasted strange.
M: Come on, Anna. Just choose one. We have to go back to the office in an hour, or we’ll be late for the meeting.
Q: Where are the man and the woman?
questions.e: 由「點餐」、「必須在一小時內回辦公室」，可知他們在餐廳裡，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Hey, Paul. This is Carol. I can’t go to the English class tonight because I have to take care of my younger brother. Can you please tell Ms. Jones about it for me? Also, I know there is a test tonight. Can I take it next Monday? Please ask Ms. Jones for me, too. By the way, may I borrow your notebook tomorrow? I want to study on my own to catch up. Thank you!
Q: Who is Paul?
questions.e: 由 Carol 請 Paul 幫她請英語課的假，以及要向 Paul 借筆記本，可知 Paul 是 Carol 的同學，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
G: What happened? You look unhappy.
B: I really want the BD-8 robot, but the sale is over. It was 800 NT dollars. Now it costs 1,000. I don’t have enough money.
G: How much do you have?
B: Only 900. I won’t get my pocket money until next month, but it is the last one in the store.
G: Hey, I can give you some money, and you’ll have 1,000 NT dollars to buy the robot today.
B: Are you serious?
G: Sure. You always help me with my homework. I’m happy to help you this time.
Q: How much might the girl give the boy?
questions.e: 男孩有九百元，女孩再給他一些錢就能買一千元的機器人，可知女孩可能會給男孩一百元，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Did you watch the magic show last night? Elena’s magic was so cool!
W: No, I didn’t. I didn’t leave the office until 8 o’clock.
M: But it only takes you fifteen to twenty minutes to drive home. How come you missed the show?
W: I didn’t go straight home. My boss had me bring a book to him before I went home.
Q: What time might the magic show start?
questions.e: 由男子認為女子八點離開公司、十五到二十分鐘後到家應該可以看到魔術表演，可知魔術表演應是在八點二十分之後開始，符合的選項只有八點三十分，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Thank you all for throwing this good-bye party for me. After Tim and I got married, we didn’t have much time to be together. Last month, we bought a new apartment in Taipei, so I’m moving there to live with him. The past two years have been wonderful, and I’m so happy to have worked with you guys here. Although I’m leaving next week, I will come back to visit you often.
Q: Which is true about the woman?
o: She prepared a party for her friend.
She is going to live with her husband.
questions.e: 由「我和 Tim 結婚」、「我要搬去那裡和他一起住」，可知這位女子將要和她先生一起住，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: How are you going to celebrate Dan’s birthday this year?
W: I bought two tickets for the basketball game between the Lions and the Bears.
M: Oh my! I can’t believe you got the tickets. They sold out in only 5 minutes. The Lions is Dan’s favorite team. He will be over the moon!
Q: What does “over the moon” mean?
questions.e: 由女子說買到獅隊與熊隊比賽的票，以及男子說獅隊是 Dan 最喜歡的球隊，可知 Dan 應該會非常開心，over the moon 即為「非常開心」、「欣喜若狂」之意，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: I heard Hank got a hundred again. You must be very proud of him.
W: Yes, but I am also worried. He always comes home late.
M: Oh, no. That doesn’t sound good. Did he make some bad friends?
W: No. He just likes to study in the library. He usually comes home at 10 and goes to bed at 1. It’s bad for his health.
Q: Why is the woman worried?
o: Her son made some bad friends.
Her son doesn’t get enough sleep.
Her son sometimes doesn’t come home.
questions.e: 由「他通常十點回家，並在一點上床睡覺。這對他的健康有害。」，可知這位女子擔心她兒子睡眠不足，故選(B)。
